description: Downloads the latest global model weights from the central server and replaces the client's local model. Use this after the server has performed aggregation to get the improved federated model.

502.detail: Failed to fetch weights from central server. Server may be unreachable at http://localhost:8000.

503.detail: Central server has no model weights available yet.

notes: The central server must be running and must have a trained model (at least one aggregation round completed, or initial weights loaded). After refreshing, the client can immediately use /local/predict with the updated model. This does NOT retrain the local model — it only downloads and applies the global weights.
